think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and allowed values from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it is a numeric parameter with an ordered range. 3) If numeric, look for sentinel/exception values (e.g., -1, 0) that change semantics (disable/enable different mode) rather than just scaling. 4) If it is boolean or enum (non-numeric), it does not fit the ‘special numerical knob’ definition. 5) Conclude whether any special sentinel value exists and report it.
